probe.text_sample: Wikimedia Enterprise - APIs for AI, Search & Knowledge Graphs Skip to content Menu APIs Docs Project Data Blog Pricing Talk to sales Sign up Free API accounts now get more requests and free Structured Contents Snapshots → Enterprise-grade APIs for Wikipedia, Wikidata & every Wikimedia project. Activate the world's largest database of collaborative open source knowledge, with dedicated SLAs, documentation, and customer support. Get Started for free → See the APIs Every project, every language, every edit, your way Full project dumps, single articles, or a firehose Snapshot API Download a whole project. Every article in any Wikimedia project, in any language, as one compressed file. Retrieve it chunk by chunk for more manageable file sizes. Snapshot API guide → On-demand API Fetch a single article. Input any article name and receive the latest revision of that article, with a single HTTP request. Filter down to the projects, languages and fields you need. On-demand API guide → Realtime API Stream every change. A firehose of edits, creations and deletions as they happen. Also available as hourly batch files.
